description: This source file defines a CMake function called 'cmake_string_to_json' that takes a string input, escapes special characters for JSON formatting, and returns the JSON-escaped string.

methods.name: cmake_string_to_json
methods.description: Converts a string into a JSON-compatible escaped string by escaping special characters like backslash, quotes, newlines, tabs, carriage return, and form feeds, then returns the escaped string.
